title: Settings > Users: Reset Password and Disable User fire immediately with no confirmation dialog
expected: Clicking Reset Password or Disable User on a user row should show a confirmation dialog before acting, since both have outward/destructive effects.
actual: Clicking Reset Password on TEST USER (ID 3090, abcd@exmaple.com) immediately sent a real password-reset email (toast: 'Success - Password reset email sent to abcd@exmaple.com'). No confirmation step exists between the row-actions menu and the action. Disable User behaves the same way. NOTE: this caused an inadvertent outward email during testing.
